label: 01-worktree
argv:
git worktree add .claude-x-codex/wt/w1 -b cxc/probe/w1
"/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/scripts/worktree-setup.sh" .claude-x-codex/wt/w1   # materialize uncommitted context

label: 02-codex-worker
argv:
F="$PWD/.claude-x-codex/probe"   # absolute, so the paths don't depend on where you cd
M=$(python3 "/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/scripts/latest-model.py" codex "${CXC_WORKER_MODEL:-luna}" --effort "${CXC_WORKER_EFFORT:-high}") || exit
CXC_MODE=off codex exec -m "$M" -c model_reasoning_effort="${CXC_WORKER_EFFORT:-high}" \
  -C .claude-x-codex/wt/w1 -s workspace-write \
  -c 'project_doc_fallback_filenames=["CLAUDE.md"]' \
  -o "$F/returns/w1.md" \
  "$(cat "$F/tasks/w1.md")" < /dev/null > "$F/returns/w1.log" 2>&1

label: 03-codex-reviewer
argv:
F="$PWD/.claude-x-codex/probe"; P="/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/skills/run/references"
M=$(python3 "/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/scripts/latest-model.py" codex "${CXC_REVIEW_MODEL:-sol}" --effort "${CXC_REVIEW_EFFORT:-xhigh}") || exit
CXC_MODE=off codex exec -m "$M" -c model_reasoning_effort="${CXC_REVIEW_EFFORT:-xhigh}" \
  -s read-only -c 'project_doc_fallback_filenames=["CLAUDE.md"]' \
  --output-schema "$P/review.schema.json" \
  -o "$F/reviews/p1-r1.json" \
  "$(cat "$F/reviews/p1-prompt.md")" < /dev/null > "$F/reviews/p1-r1.log" 2>&1

label: 04-claude-worker
argv:
cd .claude-x-codex/wt/w1 || exit; R=../../probe/returns
M=$(python3 "/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/scripts/latest-model.py" claude "${CXC_CLAUDE_WORKER:-sonnet}" --effort "${CXC_WORKER_EFFORT:-high}" --project "$PWD") || exit
CXC_MODE=off claude -p "$(cat ../../probe/tasks/w2.md)" \
  --model "$M" --effort "${CXC_WORKER_EFFORT:-high}" --permission-mode acceptEdits \
  --output-format json > "$R/w2.raw.json" < /dev/null
jq -r '.result' "$R/w2.raw.json" > "$R/w2.md"
jq -r '.modelUsage | keys[]' "$R/w2.raw.json"   # the id that ran

label: 05-claude-reviewer
argv:
F=.claude-x-codex/probe/reviews
M=$(python3 "/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/scripts/latest-model.py" claude "${CXC_CLAUDE_REVIEWER:-opus}" --effort "${CXC_REVIEW_EFFORT:-xhigh}" --project "$PWD") || exit
CXC_MODE=off claude -p "$(cat "$F/p1-prompt.md")" \
  --model "$M" --effort "${CXC_REVIEW_EFFORT:-xhigh}" \
  --allowedTools "Read" "Grep" "Glob" "Bash(git diff:*)" "Bash(git log:*)" \
  --disallowedTools "Skill" "ReportFindings" "Write" "Edit" "NotebookEdit" \
  --json-schema "$(cat "/Users/jeonjelyong/WorkSpace/Z-Work/z-lab/claude-x-codex-lab/latest-model-0.3.0/subject/claude-x-codex/skills/run/references/review.schema.json")" \
  --output-format json < /dev/null > "$F/p1-r2.raw.json"
jq '.structured_output' "$F/p1-r2.raw.json" > "$F/p1-r2.json"
jq -r '.modelUsage | keys[]' "$F/p1-r2.raw.json"   # the id that ran
